flawed.plant-cell: A labeled diagram of a plant cell. Flat-color 2D textbook illustration for a grade 5–10 science class. Solid color fills, no gradients, no shading, no photorealism, white background, thin dark outlines. Every label in clear sans-serif English with a straight leader line to its part. Draw only these labels, spelled exactly: "cell wall", "cell membrane", "cytoplasm", "nucleus", "chloroplast", "mitochondrion". No people, no faces, no hands. Do not draw any vacuole at all.
